tools.name: denext_check_snippet
tools.description: Check a denext code snippet for Next.js→denext mistakes (wrong import source, misplaced "use client", missing client boundary). Run this on code you are about to write.

tools.name: denext_import_map
tools.description: Map a Next.js/React import specifier to its denext equivalent. Omit `specifier` to get the whole table.

tools.name: denext_generate
tools.description: Scaffold a denext artifact into a project (writes files). kind = page|route|layout|component|api|action|test|docker.

tools.name: denext_doctor
tools.description: Run denext's project health check (config, app dir, route conformance) on a directory.

tools.name: denext_codemod
tools.description: Report (dry-run, no writes) the Next.js→denext import rewrites a codemod would make in a project directory.

tools.name: denext_list_routes
tools.description: List an app's routes (pages + API route handlers) with their dynamic params, by scanning app/. Works without a running dev server.

tools.name: denext_dev_logs
tools.description: Read the RUNNING dev server's recent events — server errors (with codeframes), server + browser console, completed requests (method/path/status/ms), and HMR events. Use it to see what actually happened at runtime. Requires `deno task dev` to be running.

tools.name: denext_render
tools.description: Render a route (by `path`) or a component (by `component` + `props`) server-side — NO browser — and return the HTML + status. Use it to SEE what your change actually produces (or the error it throws). Runs against the project you launched the server in.

params.name: path
params.description: A route path to render, e.g. "/blog/hello".

params.name: component
params.description: A component module path (relative to dir) to render instead of a route.

tools.name: denext_route_map
tools.description: Map everything that renders at a route path: the matched page + params, its layout and template chains (each tagged server/client), its loading/error/not-found boundaries and parallel slots, and any API route at the same path. Saves opening many files.

params.name: path
params.description: The route path to map, e.g. "/blog/hello".

tools.name: denext_search_docs
tools.description: Search the denext docs — the API reference + the authoring guide — by keyword and get the top matching symbols/sections with links and snippets. Use it to find the right denext API or rule before writing code, instead of guessing Next.js.

params.name: query
params.description: Keywords or a natural-language question, e.g. "read a session cookie".

tools.name: denext_index_codebase
tools.description: Build or refresh a searchable index of THIS project's own source code (honors the project's .gitignore). Optional — the query/definition/reference tools index on demand — but call it to warm the cache and see how many files were indexed.

tools.name: denext_query_codebase
tools.description: Search THIS project's source code for the parts relevant to a task or concept, by keyword or natural-language question. Returns the top matching file locations with snippets — use it to find where something lives before editing.

params.name: query
params.description: What to look for, e.g. "where is auth handled".

tools.name: denext_find_definition
tools.description: Find where a symbol (function, class, const, type, interface, enum) is declared in THIS project. Returns the declaration site(s), exported ones first.

tools.name: denext_find_references
tools.description: Find usages (call sites and other references) of a symbol across THIS project's source. Returns file locations with the matching line; results are capped.

params.name: symbol
params.description: The identifier to find references to.

resources.name: denext authoring guide (for AI agents)
resources.description: AGENTS.md — the rules that make code denext, not Next, plus common tasks.

resources.name: Next.js → denext import map
resources.description: How each Next.js/React import maps to its denext equivalent.
